audit_revision.correction: The v1 cohort-only check incorrectly required Docker volume names to be globally unique across independent hosted runners. Native names are deterministic and host-local. V2 binds each volume name to its verified runner_id; the original per-pair checks and every other cohort check remain unchanged. All previous evidence and reports are preserved.

checks.identity_scope: (runner_id, Docker volume name); names can repeat on independent hosts

limitations: All 10 new pairs are included; the development pair and historical answers are excluded.
Per-profile elapsed sums are sums over independent hosted jobs, not cohort calendar elapsed time. No cold-total speedup is inferred.
Complete usage/CI success does not establish source-scope or answer quality validity. Separate reviews are required.
Private assignments, anonymous packets, grading and answer semantics were not inspected.
scope: Independent execution and accounting only; no answer quality, source-tool semantic scope, comparative benefit or statistical endpoint.
unknowns: Embedding request/token usage and billable cost are not retained and remain null.
Terminal and modelUsage measurements are not provider billing or proof of unlogged background request coverage.
Per-host freshness/cleanup and source invariance rely on retained controller evidence; expired runners were not reinspected.
